about_the_game:
Frost Loop is a city building survival game set on a train in the snow.  Inspired by FrostPunk and SnowPiercer.

You start with a train car, a few people, meager resources, and build up to the ultimate train to bring humanity through this frozen apocalypse.

In Frost Loop you can

  • Build new train cars using the resources you obtain

  • Manage your people by assigning them to work various train cars or key locations across the map

  • Pilot the train by plotting out the best route between locations well avoiding the deadly storms

Beware the Storms

Keep moving to avoid being caught by one of the many roaming storms that plague this frozen land.  Getting caught means a quick frozen death.

Plan Ahead

Some storms alter the landscape permanently, creating new routes and removing old ones.  Will you always be able to reach a key location?  

Keep Hope Alive

Your workers are people too.  Keep them happy and content or risk them revolting and over throwing you.

content_descriptors.notes: Throughout the game there is a general sense of bleak environments or situations.  Many of your workers can die due to cold, accidents, or revolts.  All deaths or violence are nothing more than still images.  If you choose, or if your citizens grow discontent enough they may turn to alcohol or drugs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 20 MB available space

short_description: Frost Loop is a survival city builder set on a train in the snow. Build, Manage, and Pilot the train carrying the last of humanity in a world of snow and storms. Can the warmth of humanity survive on the run? Or is it destined to go cold.
